verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas's own Editor docs explicitly claim "Make a change, see it instantly": live editing lets you modify scripts while the application runs, which directly matches the hot-reload / near-instant-preview story. The no-build-step Web Components path and the Vite scaffolding support a quick iteration loop, though the docs do not explicitly state hot reload for those paths. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how script hot-swapping works (state preservation, scope, limitations), explicit hot-reload behavior for the standalone Engine/Vite workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration of edit-run speed.
